caption:
🔥 बॉक्स ऑफिस पर सूर्या की फिल्म का तूफान जारी है! 🎬
तमिल क्राइम-कॉमेडी ड्रामा Scene ने सिनेमाघरों में अपने सात दिन पूरे कर लिए हैं। 💥
जिथू माधवन द्वारा निर्देशित इस फिल्म में सूर्या, नज़रिया नाज़िम और नसलेन मुख्य भूमिकाओं में हैं। 🤩
फिल्म ने सिर्फ छह दिनों में ही सौ करोड़ का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया था। 📈
सातवें दिन फिल्म ने छह दशमलव एक करोड़ रुपये कमाए, जो इसका अब तक का सबसे कम सिंगल-डे टोटल है। 📉
छहवें दिन के आठ दशमलव शून्य पांच करोड़ रुपये के मुकाबले इसमें चौबीस दशमलव दो प्रतिशत की गिरावट दर्ज हुई है। 📊
सात दिनों के बाद फिल्म का भारत में नेट टोटल एक सौ ग्यारह दशमलव पचपन करोड़ रुपये हो गया है। 🇮🇳
भारत का ग्रॉस कलेक्शन एक सौ इकतीस दशमलव त्रेसठ करोड़ रुपये पहुंच गया है और ओवरसीज में इहत्तर करोड़ की कमाई हुई है। 💰
दुनियाभर में इसका कुल कलेक्शन दो सौ दो दशमलव त्रेसठ करोड़ रुपये हो गया है। 🌍
यह फिल्म सूर्या के करियर का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा ओपनिंग वीक बन गई है। 🏆
क्या यह फिल्म ग्लोबल बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तीन सौ करोड़ का आंकड़ा पार कर पाएगी? 🤔

ctx.title: Scene Box Office Day 7: Suriya’s Film Registers 2nd Biggest Opening Week Of His Career
ctx.summary:
Suriya's latest film, Scene, has crossed the 100 crore mark in India in just its opening week. It is only the second film in Suriya's career to achieve this feat. 
 The post  Scene Box Office Day 7: Suriya’s Film Registers 2nd Biggest Opening Week Of His Career  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The Tamil crime-comedy drama, Scene, has completed a week at the box office. Directed by Jithu Madhavan, the film also stars Nazriya Nazim and Naslen. The film crossed the 100 crore mark in just six days. It also crossed the 200 crore mark worldwide in its opening week.
The Tamil film marked Suriya’s third release of the year. He was earlier seen in Karuppu and Vishwanath And Sons. All three of his releases have crossed the 200 crore mark at the global box office.
On its seventh day, Scene earned 6.1 crore , which was its lowest single-day total. It registered a 24.2% drop from its Day 6 collection of 8.05 crore . The film’s India net total after seven days stands at 111.55 crore . This brings its India gross to 131.63 crore . Overseas, the film has earned 71 crore , taking its worldwide total to 202.63 crore .
Scene has become the second-biggest opening week of Suriya’s career. It has surpassed Vishwanath And Sons’ opening-week collection of 81.6 crore , but remains behind his earlier release, Karuppu. At its current pace, Scene is likely to cross the 300 crore mark globally.
Top 5 Opening Week Collections Of Suriya’s Career (India Net)
Directed by Jithu Madhavan, the film narrates the story of Crime Branch Inspector Inbaraj ( Suriya ), who wishes to resign from his job. However, his senior does not allow him to do so, as he considers Inbaraj the best on the team. During this time, Inbaraj’s skills are questioned when a serial killer starts imitating a notorious killer whom Inbaraj had previously caught. As questions are raised about Inbaraj’s investigation, he returns to catch the copycat serial killer.
